description: The comparator stages fair contests between models: same tasks, same metrics, same conditions, with each model's assumptions documented and its reality grade labeled. title: Fair contest design algorithm
description: A fair contest gives every model the same tasks, the same inputs, the same metrics, and no peeking at the answers. title: Assumption sensitivity algorithm

title: Failure modes: leakage and grade fraud
description: Contests fail when models peek at answers or when simulated results masquerade as measured. The comparator defends with leakage detection (train/test overlap analysis), grade auditing, and a fraud ledger for violations. A caught cheater is disqualified publicly within the system — deterrence is part of the design.
